svg.aria-label: A game message laid out byte by byte: magic, type, sequence number, length and body, and many messages as rows
svg.title: A game message laid out byte by byte: magic, type, sequence number, length and body, and many messages as rows
svg.text: One message, and forty of them side by side: the fields line up as columns.
a smooth ramp: the sequence counter
three repeating values: the message type
noise: the body, or compressed data
